located_observations.location: Rightmost coral pot and supporting hand, about x1430–1672, y480–630
located_observations.observation: One connected forearm enters from the right. Thumb rests against the pot wall; several curved fingers wrap below the lower pot edge. This gives a concrete selection/support action. The hand partially hides the pot's lower wall.

Fine olive contour work and printed botanical color planes stay on images; type is crisp flat dark ink. Table shadows anchor the pots. No visible logo, QR, label, arrow, bullet, invented plant tag or additional copy.
